checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: ~10s widescreen video with friendly intelligible English voice-over explaining the cycle
must.why: Wide 10s video with audio present, but words and tone can't be judged.

must.item: Water rises as vapor, clouds form, rain falls, in order
must.why: Clouds already exist at 1s with rain; clouds grow, but no visible vapor rising from the lake, and rain is present from the start, so the order is not clear.

must.item: Visible labels read exactly Evaporation, Condensation, Precipitation
Each label legible and appears with its stage in order

faults.what: No Evaporation/Condensation/Precipitation labels, which the checklist requires (the user had not asked for them, but they are required here).
Evaporation isn't shown; rain is already falling at 1s, so the stages are not sequenced clearly.
Clouds grow to cover the mountain and sun with a mostly static scene; the stream flows from the mountain top as a thin line, which is physically odd.

summary: A clean, pretty cartoon landscape of a lake, mountain, sun, and growing rain clouds came out, but it has no stage labels and doesn't clearly show vapor rising before the clouds and rain.
